g.text: These four channels let the MIRA power controller monitor the protected input

g.desc: These four channels let the MIRA power controller monitor the protected input

g.text: bus and the AON, USB and system rails. Current alerts also feed the hardware

g.desc: bus and the AON, USB and system rails. Current alerts also feed the hardware

g.text: interlocks, allowing switched supplies to be disabled without waiting for

g.desc: interlocks, allowing switched supplies to be disabled without waiting for

g.text: U3501 senses BUS24_PRE_SHUNT to BUS24. U3502-U3504 sense AON_RAW/AON,

g.desc: U3501 senses BUS24_PRE_SHUNT to BUS24. U3502-U3504 sense AON_RAW/AON,

g.text: USB_RAW/USB5 and SYS_RAW/SYS3V3. MON_I_* and MON_V_* feed the telemetry

g.desc: USB_RAW/USB5 and SYS_RAW/SYS3V3. MON_I_* and MON_V_* feed the telemetry

g.text: multiplexers; MON_V_USB also feeds the analog power-good comparator. All

g.desc: multiplexers; MON_V_USB also feeds the analog power-good comparator. All

g.text: INA301 ALERT outputs share OC_OK_N: a low level signals an overcurrent. RESET is

g.desc: INA301 ALERT outputs share OC_OK_N: a low level signals an overcurrent. RESET is

g.text: grounded, selecting transparent mode; fault memory is on the interlock sheet.

g.desc: grounded, selecting transparent mode; fault memory is on the interlock sheet.

g.text: U3501 provides input-current telemetry without a hardware alert.

g.desc: U3501 provides input-current telemetry without a hardware alert.

g.text: The BAT54S pairs clamp voltage nodes toward GND and AON. Telemetry filters do

g.desc: The BAT54S pairs clamp voltage nodes toward GND and AON. Telemetry filters do

g.text: not delay the INA301 internal comparator. OC_OK_N uses external AON pullups on

g.desc: not delay the INA301 internal comparator. OC_OK_N uses external AON pullups on

g.text: the ADC-buffer and negative-overcurrent sheets; trip settings must be checked

g.desc: the ADC-buffer and negative-overcurrent sheets; trip settings must be checked

g.text: Current scales: input 0.4 V/A with the stated external 0.02 Ohm shunt; AON 2

g.desc: Current scales: input 0.4 V/A with the stated external 0.02 Ohm shunt; AON 2

g.text: V/A; USB 1 V/A; SYS 0.2 V/A. The 10 kOhm LIMIT resistors set 0.8 V, giving

g.desc: V/A; USB 1 V/A; SYS 0.2 V/A. The 10 kOhm LIMIT resistors set 0.8 V, giving

g.text: nominal trips of 0.4 A, 0.8 A and 4 A. Voltage scales are input/16 and other

g.desc: nominal trips of 0.4 A, 0.8 A and 4 A. Voltage scales are input/16 and other

g.text: rails/2. Each 1 kOhm / 10 nF current filter has a 10 us time constant.

g.desc: rails/2. Each 1 kOhm / 10 nF current filter has a 10 us time constant.

g.text: Input, AON, USB and system monitoring

g.desc: Input, AON, USB and system monitoring

g.text: External 0.02 Ohm: 0.4 V/A. Voltage divided by 16.

g.desc: External 0.02 Ohm: 0.4 V/A. Voltage divided by 16.
